looks_wrong.what: The header status line swaps 'Topic test · question 5 of 10' for 'Good — keep going.', so the question number disappears after each correct step.
Footer reads 'Step 2 of 3' while step 3 is the active step.
Hint 1 is shown inside the already-completed green step 1 card, below the 'Correct' line. It looks like leftover clutter.

would_quit.quote: Step 3: "Find y when x = 25." — the student gives up here and leaves the question unfinished.
would_quit.why: Third step of a 2-mark question, after a no-input 'Next' step. It is halfway through a 10-question test with no end in sight for a bored teen.

fixes.change: Update 'Step N of M' when a step unlocks (including after a statement step's Next), not only on reload.
Keep 'Question 5 of 10' visible and show 'Good — keep going.' alongside it rather than replacing it.
Add a 'Carry on your M3 topic test (question 5 of 10) →' card at the top when a test is in progress.
Record the warm-up and the in-progress topic test as a session so History is not 'No sessions yet'.
Merge 'Equation: y = 3√x' into step 3's prompt so there is no extra Next tap.
